fair-contract-won.headline: Our agreement. Our vote.
fair-contract-won.summary: The strike was called off September 28. Our tentative agreement is now before members for ratification. Review the summary, bring your questions to a meeting, and use your personal ballot email to vote.
fair-contract-won.promoHeadline: Find your ballot. Make your voice heard.
fair-contract-won.promoBody: Look for SEIU 503’s October 5 email, “Vote on Contract Ratification Now!” Voting is online; informational meetings do not include a vote.

higher-ed-strike-pledge.headline: Impasse declared. Sign the Higher Ed strike pledge.
higher-ed-strike-pledge.summary: Sept. 27 bargaining update: Our team is seeking 3% for everyone on Nov. 1 and 6% over two years for workers earning under $25 an hour. Management’s reported first-year offer is 2.25%. Prepare for the Sept. 28 strike unless our union announces otherwise.
higher-ed-strike-pledge.promoHeadline: Wages. Health care. Job security. Respect.
higher-ed-strike-pledge.promoBody: Management's package would leave our pay behind rising costs while weakening protections that classified workers have built over decades.

image.alt: SEIU Local 503 Higher Education bargaining team members meet around tables during August mediation.

details.label: Where things stand
details.value: Impasse preserves our right to strike if management does not make genuine movement

details.label: What management offers
details.value: Sept. 27: management’s reported first-year offer is 2.25%; our team seeks 3% on Nov. 1

details.label: What we can do
details.value: Sign the pledge, wear purple, take action and talk with coworkers

actionPage.headline: Impasse declared: Sign the Higher Ed strike pledge
actionPage.body: Sept. 27 bargaining update: Our team is seeking 3% for everyone on Nov. 1 and 6% over two years for workers earning under $25 an hour. Management’s reported first-year offer is 2.25%. Prepare for the Sept. 28 strike unless our union announces otherwise.
actionPage.nextStep: The pledge is not a strike-authorization vote. Sign it, then ask 10 coworkers to stand with you.

hell-no-president-email.headline: Take 3 actions with our union for a fair contract
hell-no-president-email.summary: Oregon State University management is stalling. Email OSU leadership, sign the strike pledge and build our union with one coworker conversation.
hell-no-president-email.promoHeadline: One email. One pledge. One conversation.
hell-no-president-email.promoBody: Each action builds our power and shows OSU that classified staff are informed, organized and ready to stand with one another.

image.alt: A purple background with silhouettes of raised fists and campus mascots, featuring the Higher Education Bargaining 2026 message.

details.label: Email
details.value: Email OSU leadership and demand a fair contract

details.label: Pledge
details.value: Read and sign our union's strike pledge

details.label: Organize
details.value: Become a member or ask one coworker to join

ctas.label: Take 3 actions for a fair contract

actionPage.headline: Take 3 actions with our union for a fair contract
actionPage.body: Our collective power comes from members moving together. Email OSU leadership, sign the strike pledge and build our union by becoming a member or asking one coworker to join.
actionPage.nextStep: Start with the email, then use the action hub to sign the strike pledge and choose another way to build our union.

membership-july-16.headline: Membership meeting Thursday, July 16
membership-july-16.summary: We are in a new phase of bargaining. Table details are confidential for now, but our public job is clear: higher ed works because we work, and we need members ready to move together.
membership-july-16.promoHeadline: Higher ed works because we work.
membership-july-16.promoBody: Join us at noon in Memorial Union room 215. Lunch is provided, Zoom details are coming shortly, and we will talk through how members can show OSU and higher ed that our power is disciplined, organized, and visible.

image.alt: A purple background with silhouettes of raised fists and campus mascots, featuring the Higher Education Bargaining 2026 message.

details.label: When
details.value: Thursday, July 16, noon to 1 p.m.

details.label: Where
details.value: Memorial Union room 215

details.label: Bring
details.value: A coworker and your questions

actionPage.headline: Show up for the July 16 membership meeting
actionPage.body: The bargaining team is in confidential negotiations, so the details from the table stay internal for now. What we can do publicly is build member readiness: attend the meeting, bring a coworker, join the CAT, and be ready to show OSU that higher ed workers are organized.
actionPage.nextStep: After the membership meeting, the CAT meets Monday evening, July 20, to coordinate coworker outreach and next steps.

cat-july-20.headline: CAT meeting Monday evening, July 20
cat-july-20.summary: Join the Contract Action Team meeting to coordinate coworker outreach and keep our worksites moving together.
cat-july-20.promoHeadline: Help carry the update back to your worksite.
cat-july-20.promoBody: The CAT meeting is where members turn updates into coworker conversations and visible action. Time and Zoom details are coming shortly.

image.alt: SEIU Local 503 at Oregon State University card graphic.

details.label: When
details.value: Monday evening, July 20

details.label: Where
details.value: Details coming soon

details.label: Focus
details.value: Coworker outreach and action coordination

actionPage.headline: Help carry the update back to your worksite
actionPage.body: CAT members share updates, listen to coworkers, and help turn member readiness into visible workplace power.
actionPage.nextStep: Invite one coworker who wants to help but has not joined CAT yet.
